description.value: The Dayton Audio SS12-22 Signature Series 12" Subwoofer delivers exceptional low-frequency performance from compact enclosures. Engineered for high-output systems that require both accuracy and authority, the SS12-22 combines a rigid anodized aluminum cone, dual-spider suspension, and a powerful FEA-optimized motor structure for clean, controlled bass even at long excursion. Its 3" 4-layer copper voice coil on a vented aluminum former ensures excellent thermal handling, supporting up to 900 watts RMS with minimal compression. Whether used in DSP assisted sealed enclosures for tight, articulate bass or in small vented/passive radiator systems for maximum extension, the SS12-22 provides the performance, control, and durability demanded by serious listeners. Product Highlights Rigid anodized aluminum cone with indexed edge for pistonic accuracy and reduced resonance 3" 4-layer copper voice coil on a vented aluminum former for superior power handling and cooling FEA-optimized motor with triple-stacked magnets delivers exceptional strength and symmetry at high excursion Extensive venting through cone, pole piece, spider, and gap minimizes thermal buildup and compression Aluminum shorting sleeve, ring, and pole cap ensure linear inductance and ultra-low distortion Dual spider suspension with stitched tinsel leads for precise pistonic motion and long-term reliability

model.value: SS12-22 12" Signature Series DVC Subwoofer 2 Ohms per Coil
